description: What a metric name actually means: its unit, the fields its values carry, which entity types have it, which sources feed it, how its values are distributed across observed / derived / estimated / imputed, and one example with a citable fact_url. Useful for checking a predicate name or the provenance of a number. The description is read from a sample of at most 200 facts and says so in the response — field lists and status shares are indicative, not exhaustive. For the exact coverage of one entity use get_timeseries.
name: describe_predicate
title: Describe a metric
